title: weekly sync - serving runtime / infra / console - agenda & prep (2026-04-27)
body:
Purpose:
Quick alignment across serving runtime, infra, and console teams. Surface blockers, sync on rollout plan for KV cache changes, and confirm dashboards/observability for next week.

Attendees (opt-in):
- Core: Alex (owner), Jordan (infra), Samira (console), Carlos (runtime)
- Optional: PM (TBD), SRE rep

Timebox: 45 minutes

1) Quick status (10m)
- Runtime: perf numbers from latest quantized build (Carlos) - brief top-line (p50/p95 tokens/sec, mem).
- Infra: cluster autoscaler test pass/fail, spot capacity report (Jordan).
- Console: per-route latency dashboard changes deployed to staging (Samira).
Notes to self: bring the perf-compare chart from /runtime/benchmarks (slide 3).

2) KV cache rollout plan (15m) - deep dive (Alex + Carlos)
- Goal: enable prefix KV caching by default for medium-latency routes next week (canary 5% -> 25%).
- Risks: cache eviction behavior under mixed seq len workload, memory bloat on small-GPU SKUs.
- Required infra changes: eviction monitoring metric + alert (INFRA-112), small change to node memory requests.
Open questions (for discussion):
- Acceptable p95 latency delta during canary? propose <= +10% but need buy-in.
- If we see >5% error spikes, what's rollback window? propose immediate rollback + postmortem.

3) Observability gaps (10m)
- Console: need route-level token breakdown (Samira). Current dashboard shows aggregate only.
- Runtime: want a tag on traces for cache-hit vs miss to show end-to-end latency delta (Carlos).
Action: Samira to prototype a dashboard widget, Carlos to add trace tag.

4) Operational runbook updates (5m)
- Update runbook for cache OOM scenarios and autoscaler tuning. Link to runbook draft in linked_artifacts.

5) Blockers / Parking lot (if time)
- Billing anomaly from Dedicated customers after recent batch change - flagged by finance, need debug owner.
- Infra quota request for new GPU types pending.

Prep notes / things I need to bring:
- Perf chart (runtime/benchmarks) + raw numbers (CSV)
- Example trace showing cache hit vs miss (from staging)
- Draft runbook snippet for OOM handling

Tone: keep it pragmatic. We want quick decisions for canary thresholds and concrete owners for alerts.

Personal scratchpad (unpolished):
- If Jordan can get eviction metric in by EOD Mon we can launch 5% canary Tue morning.
- Consider rolling canary by customer (dedicated vs hosted) rather than route sets? might reduce blast radius but more complex routing logic.
- Follow up 1:1 with Samira to confirm dashboard filters she needs.
action_items: Alex: Finalize KV cache canary plan doc (thresholds, rollback criteria) and share in #runtime by 2026-04-28
Jordan: Add eviction-rate metric and alert (INFRA-112). Target: staging by 2026-04-29
Samira: Prototype route-level token breakdown dashboard widget in staging; demo in next weekly (2026-05-04)
Carlos: Add cache-hit vs miss trace tag and capture example traces in staging; provide sample trace link by 2026-04-30
Carlos & Jordan: Confirm memory request changes for small-GPU SKUs and test autoscaler impact; report by 2026-05-01
Alex: Schedule 30m follow-up w/PM to confirm customer canary segmentation (2026-04-29)
